The search turned up the official OpenAI deprecations page plus several third-party summaries. The official snippets list these upcoming shutdowns:

- **December 11, 2026:** older GPT-5 snapshots (gpt-5-2025-08-07, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06) and the dated o3 and o3-pro snapshots. OpenAI points to gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano, and gpt-5.5-pro as replacements. OpenAI notified developers on June 11, 2026 about the removal of older GPT-5 and o3 snapshots from the API on December 11, 2026.
- **December 1, 2026:** the older GPT Image models (gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, and chatgpt-image-latest), with gpt-image-2 as the suggested replacement. The table lists the December 1, 2026 shutdown for these three models, each pointing to gpt-image-2.
- **November 30, 2026:** the v1/prompts API and reusable prompt objects. They are scheduled to shut down on November 30, 2026.
- **August 10, 2026:** gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest snapshots, both pointing to gpt-5.5. The official table lists August 10, 2026 for both.

Third-party summaries also mention an October 23, 2026 shutdown for the older GPT-4-era models and o-series snapshots, plus gpt-image-1. One of them states that the Assistants API shuts down on August 26, 2026, and the Videos API and Sora 2 models shut down on September 24, 2026. I could not confirm those last dates against the official page in these results, so verify them there.

Two other points from the results:
- OpenAI's stated policy, as described by a third-party analysis, is at least six months' notice for generally available models and at least three months for specialized variants such as Codex and chat-latest models.
- Fine-tuning access is changing too. Active existing customers will no longer be able to create new fine-tuning jobs on January 6, 2027. Inference on fine-tuned models continues until the base model is deprecated.

Some of the third-party pages are dated after today (October 17, 2026), so their content may be unreliable. The official page at developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations is the authoritative source, and it can change after announcement.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

content.text:
**Official page:** https://developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations. The older platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations address is the previous home of the same page.

I couldn't open the page directly because the fetch tool's proxy refused the connection. The dates below come from search-result snippets of the official page and are unverified. Check them against the page before relying on them.

**Next retirements after today (Oct 17, 2026), soonest first:**

| Shutdown date | What's retiring | Suggested replacement |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 30, 2026 | The `v1/prompts` API and reusable prompt objects | Not stated in the snippets |
| Dec 1, 2026 | `gpt-image-1-mini`, `gpt-image-1.5`, `chatgpt-image-latest` | `gpt-image-2` |
| Dec 11, 2026 | Older GPT-5 snapshots (`gpt-5-2025-08-07`, `gpt-5-mini`, `gpt-5-nano`, `gpt-5-pro-2025-10-06`) and the dated `o3` and `o3-pro` snapshots | `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.4-nano`, `gpt-5.5-pro` |

- **Oct 23, 2026:** third-party summaries (not the official page) list a shutdown for older GPT-4-era and o-series snapshots and `gpt-image-1`. I couldn't confirm it, but it would be the soonest if accurate.
- **Fine-tuning:** from Jan 6, 2027, active existing customers can no longer create new fine-tuning jobs. Inference on fine-tuned models continues until the base model is deprecated.
- **Already past:** the `gpt-5.2-chat-latest` and `gpt-5.3-chat-latest` snapshots had an Aug 10, 2026 shutdown.
